integrity: Every vertex subset, face-poset Hasse relation, signed-coordinate automorphism and Fourier multiplicity can be reconstructed by the embedded exact verifier and compared to independent membership and Alexander-dual tests. Independent mathematical validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact four-cube rational automorphism character at the four-robust threshold; does not identify an integral equivariant lattice, quotient torsion, an equivariant sphere basis or a uniform higher-dimensional formula. The existing nonequivariant rank 529 is explicitly credited as prior art.
title: Complete hyperoctahedral character of the four-robust clique complex of the Boolean four-cube
